fusions.name: Ridge Ram
fusions.desc: A headlong ram that deals 14 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Crag Breaker
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then butts it for 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cliffside Poise
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
